# leak-gate: forbidden CONTENT patterns (clean-room red lines)
#
# One POSIX ERE per line. Blank lines and lines starting with "#" are comments.
# Every pattern is matched case-insensitively against the contents of every
# tracked file. ANY match fails the build.
#
# ── Maintenance rules (read before editing) ────────────────────────────────
# 1. Matching is case-insensitive on purpose. The original manual pattern was
#    written `ibattpro`, but the actual vendor artifact is `ibattPRO0225.apk`
#    -- a case-sensitive grep would have missed the exact file it was written
#    to catch. Keep the patterns lowercase and let the runner pass -i.
# 2. Adding a pattern is a normal change. REMOVING or narrowing one requires
#    an owner ruling. If a legitimate document needs a word that is on this
#    list, that is an owner decision about the document OR about the pattern
#    -- never a unilateral edit here to make CI go green.
# 3. This file and the two other files of the gate itself are the ONLY paths
#    excluded from the content scan (they necessarily quote the patterns).
#    The runner enforces that this directory contains nothing else.
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# --- Decompiler toolchain and its output tree. ---
blutter
out_blutter

# --- Vendor app artifacts / internal database names. ---
ibattpro
ibattdb

# --- Chinese-language giveaways from the internal research notes. ---
# NOTE: literal Chinese strings are exactly the kind of pattern that goes
# stale. See "What this gate CANNOT catch" in ../workflows/leak-gate.yml.
消費版原始碼
工程版

# --- Internal naming for the engineering-build protocol material. ---
protocol-engineer
engineer build
